title: Towards a Mechanistic Understanding of Propositional Logical Reasoning in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2601.04260v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Understanding how Large Language Models (LLMs) perform logical reasoning internally remains a fundamental challenge. While prior mechanistic studies focus on identifying task specific circuits, they leave open the question of what computational strategies LLMs employ for propositional reasoning. We address this gap with a causal mechanistic analysis on PropLogic-MI, a controlled benchmark of 11 propositional rules across one- and two-hop tasks, applied to three model families (Qwen3, Llama-3.1, Mistral). Rather than asking which components are necessary, we ask how the reasoning process is organized, and identify four interlocking mechanisms: Staged Computation, where early, middle, and late layers take on distinct functional roles; Information Transmission, where semantic content aggregates at boundary tokens; Fact Retrospection, where fact tokens stay causally active as binding lookup in middle layers and as sustained access in lat

translated_title: 迈向对大语言模型中命题逻辑推理的机制性理解
translated_abstract: 理解大语言模型内部如何执行逻辑推理仍然是一个根本性挑战。尽管以往的机制性研究侧重于识别特定任务的电路，但它们尚未解决大语言模型在命题推理中采用何种计算策略这一问题。我们通过对 PropLogic-MI 的因果机制分析来填补这一空白——PropLogic-MI 是一个受控基准，涵盖跨单跳和双跳任务的 11 条命题规则，并应用于三个模型家族。我们不再追问哪些组件是必要的，而是探究推理过程是如何组织的，并识别出四种相互关联的机制：分阶段计算，其中早期、中期和后期层承担不同的功能角色；信息传递，其中语义内容在边界标记处聚合；事实回溯，其中事实标记保持因果活跃，作为中间层中的绑定查找以及后期的持续访问……
tldr: 该研究通过在三个模型家族上进行因果机制分析，揭示了大语言模型执行命题逻辑推理时四种相互关联的内部机制（分阶段计算、信息传递、事实回溯等），为理解大模型推理过程的组织方式提供了机制性解释。
en_tdlr: Through causal mechanistic analysis across three model families, this study identifies four interlocking internal mechanisms (staged computation, information transmission, fact retrospection, etc.) underlying how large language models organize propositional logical reasoning.
